text:
Added PayPal checkout (PayPal / Venmo / Pay Later) alongside the existing card form. All 10 tests pass (5 existing + 5 new); no live PayPal calls were made and nothing was committed.

**Server**
- `lib/paypal.js` (new): PayPal REST client — OAuth, order create/capture, webhook-signature verification. Reads `PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID`, `PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET`, `PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID` from the environment (never exposed to the browser), and sends every REST call to `PAYPAL_API_BASE` (default `https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com`). The browser SDK URL is built from `PAYPAL_ENV` only (`www.sandbox.paypal.com` vs `www.paypal.com`, never from `PAYPAL_API_BASE`), with `components=buttons,messages`, `enable-funding=venmo,paylater`, and in sandbox `buyer-country` from `PAYPAL_TEST_BUYER_COUNTRY`.
- `server.js`: `GET /api/paypal/config` (client id, env, `testBuyerCountry`, SDK URL — no secrets), `POST /api/paypal/orders`, `POST /api/paypal/orders/:id/capture`, and `POST /api/paypal/webhooks`. The bag is priced server-side from the catalog (browser-sent prices/amounts ignored); capture and webhooks are verified as COMPLETED for the exact local total/currency and bound to the local order before fulfilment. Approval alone never ships, unverified/mismatched payments never ship, and capture+webhook settle through one gate so an order ships exactly once. Without PayPal credentials the PayPal endpoints return 503 and cards keep working.
- `lib/db.js`: stores the PayPal order id per local order (migrated column + lookup) so capture/webhooks can find it.

**Browser**
- `public/index.html` / `app.js` / `styles.css`: a "Pay with PayPal, Venmo or Pay Later" section with PayPal Buttons and Pay Later messaging above the card form; `createOrder`/`onApprove` call the server endpoints above (server captures and verifies before confirmation).

Also updated `README.md`/`package.json` docs, added `test/paypal.test.js` covering SDK-URL selection, server pricing, amount-mismatch rejection, and webhook idempotency against a recording fake PayPal API, and smoke-tested `node server.js` end-to-end (env config → create → capture → fulfilled) against a local PayPal stub.
